content:
The highly anticipated television Emmy Awards kick off this weekend, with the Creative Arts categories revealing their winners first. The primetime ceremony will be held on September 14, when top honours such as Outstanding Drama Series and Outstanding Comedy Series will be handed out.

For now, Apple has every reason to feel pleased with the acclaim it has received — Apple TV+ surged into the weekend leading the pack with a record-breaking 20 awards. The lion's share of that haul comes from the comedy "Widows Bay," which swept up 8 prizes and is now a hot favourite for the top comedy category award.

As it stands, Apple leads the 2026 Emmys with 20 awards, followed by HBO Max with 16 and Netflix with 13. Once the primetime Emmys are all handed out, the latter two are expected to overtake Apple in the overall tally, but Apple can still lay claim to a respectable third place.

Apple is expected to shine brightly in the comedy categories, though in drama it may be outclassed by contenders such as "The Pitt." The answers will be revealed next Monday.

As things stand, "Widows Bay" has taken 8 awards, "Pluribus" has taken 4, "Margo's Got Money Troubles" has taken 3, "Palm Royale" has also taken 3, and the documentary "Mr Scorsese" has taken 1.

Apple TV+ titles have collected 19 awards; add the 1 award won by Apple's "I'm Not Remarkable" advertisement, and the total rounds out at 20:

"Widow’s Bay"

  • Outstanding Guest Actress in a Comedy Series: Betty Gilpin
  • Outstanding Production Design for a Narrative Program (Half-Hour)
  • Outstanding Casting for a Comedy Series
  • Outstanding Cinematography for a Series (Half-Hour)
  • Outstanding Original Music for a Series (Original Dramatic Score)
  • Outstanding Music Supervision
  • Outstanding Sound Editing for a Comedy or Drama Series (Half-Hour) and Animation
  • Outstanding Sound Mixing for a Comedy or Drama Series (Half-Hour) and Animation

"Pluribus"

  • Outstanding Production Design for a Contemporary Narrative Program (One Hour or More)
  • Outstanding Editing for a Drama Series
  • Outstanding Original Main Title Theme Music
  • Outstanding Sound Mixing for a Comedy or Drama Series (One Hour)

"Margo's Got Money Troubles"

  • Outstanding Contemporary Costumes for a Series
  • Outstanding Contemporary Hairstyling
  • Outstanding Contemporary Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)

"Palm Royale"

  • Outstanding Choreography for a Scripted Program
  • Outstanding Period Costumes
  • Outstanding Period or Fantasy/Sci-Fi Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)

"Mr. Scorsese"

  • Outstanding Documentary or Nonfiction Series

Apple TV+ began the season with a record-breaking 89 Emmy nominations; by the time the primetime Emmy Awards ceremony rolls around on September 14, we'll see just how many more of those nominations can be converted into wins. Once again, it all reflects the esteem in which industry critics hold the overall quality of Apple's programming.
